2014_spells.leomunds-secret-chest.descri: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the replica that serves as a material component for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 4 feet by 2 feet).
2014_spells.leomunds-secret-chest.effect: Change a target: the chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 4 feet by 2 feet)
2014_spells.leomunds-secret-chest.fullDe: Using 1 action, you must touch the chest and the replica that serves as a material component for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 4 feet by 2 feet); You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
